verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Productboard feature that lets a user set up automations, triggers or schedules that run on their own in the background. What it does show is adjacent: webhooks and REST/MCP APIs that developers or external agents could use to build automation, a built-in agent that synthesizes information when invoked, and automatic insight detection in feedback, which is a fixed built-in behavior rather than a user-configured automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
